description: This file defines the `CardsRepository` class in Dart, responsible for managing a list of bank cards. It interacts with shared preferences for persistent storage and provides methods to load, save, and update card statuses.

classes.name: CardsRepository
classes.description: Manages operations related to a list of bank cards, including loading, saving, and updating card information in shared preferences.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads the list of bank cards from shared preferences; initializes with default seed data if none exists.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the provided list of bank cards to shared preferences.

methods.name: setStatus
methods.description: Updates the status of a specific card identified by cardId.
